purpose: Durable archive and retention contract required before a one-year or 20-year HICAR campaign may be authorized.

recovery_foundation.scope: Compact rebuild-critical recovery foundation; not a routine annual-production output archive.

storage_policy.role: Backed, high-resilience online storage for medium- to long-term retention.
storage_policy.namespace_policy: /store_new/mch/msopr/olifu is the permanent authoritative project namespace and must not be rewritten to another storage prefix.

archived: Unpushed HICAR commit histories and the exact local dirty source patch.
Exact Swiss 200 m static domains and REA-L land initialization.
Fieldextra executable/configuration identity, ICON grid, and selected public OGD inputs.
Minimal v1/v2 failed national restart trajectories and all canonical v1/v2/v3 restart reports.
regenerable_not_archived: Bulk raw model history and ordinary build directories.
Authoritative REA-L fields retained in institutional FDB.

classification_and_candidates.rationale: The outputs are reproducible climate grids retained for validation and later analysis; the approved MeteoSwiss guideline lists climate grids as the example for facultative retention rather than irreplaceable national-heritage archiving.

capacity_screen.interpretation: The current tape plan is smaller than even the lower routine-output estimate and does not include checkpoints, validation products, wind-climatology products, or transfer headroom.

classification_and_candidates.required_decision: The data owner and CSCS division SPOC must select a durable tier, assign at least the measured campaign envelope plus headroom, and approve a project-owned destination before a transfer test.

scratch_policy.raw_history_retirement: Only after lossless compressed publication, checksum verification, all scientific reports, and durable archive acknowledgement.
scratch_policy.forcing_retirement: Only after model output and exact-end restart publication for the consuming segment.

required_for_approval: Named durable destination outside scratch with responsible owner and quota.
Immutable per-segment manifest containing source requests, configuration and executable hashes, output/restart checksums, validation reports, and compression provenance.
Measured transfer throughput and one restore/readback drill on a month-pilot artifact.
Documented retention periods for compressed routine output, selected checkpoints, forcing manifests, validation reports, and raw transient files.
Failure-recovery policy for partial transfer, checksum mismatch, interrupted model segments, and unavailable FDB records.
Approved 200 m and 100 m storage envelopes, including rolling restart peaks and observation/reference products.
interpretation: UNRESOLVED intentionally blocks GO_ANNUAL_CYCLE and every 20-year production decision. It does not block the bounded 31-day scientific pilot.
